newsitem.title: JAPAN: Green Cross bid-only on restructuring measures.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross bid-only on restructuring measures.

text.p: Green Cross Corp shares were bid-only in early morning Tuesday trade as investors showed their approval of the restructuring plans which the company announced late last week, brokers said.
As of 0040 GMT, the shares were bid only at 427 yen after closing at 417 yen on Friday. Tokyo markets were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
On Friday, the pharmaceutical maker said it would sell off a total 11 billion yen worth of its land holdings and shares in other companies before the end of the 2000/01 business year.
It also said it would reduce operational costs by a total of 6.3 billion yen before the end of March 1998 through such measures as curbing spending in research and development.
